title: Windows-native Firstmate spike closure
north_star: Demonstrate that Firstmate can complete end-to-end, natively on Windows, one real .NET/WPF development task: create an isolated worker, modify code, run Windows build/tests, return the result to the Primary, and close the task, without WSL and without target-application workarounds.

architecture_under_test.controller_shell: Git Bash/MSYS used as Firstmate's Bash scripting layer
architecture_under_test.explicit_non_goal: This spike did not attempt a PowerShell-first rewrite of Firstmate. Git Bash was the scripting/control layer while execution and target tooling remained native Windows.

north_star_milestones.name: Primary session acquisition
north_star_milestones.evidence: Natural Pi extension loading on Windows propagated the native Pi PID and acquired/retained the Firstmate session lock. A later manual fm-session-start invocation was proven to be a false-negative path because it bypassed that PID injection.

north_star_milestones.name: Treehouse isolation
north_star_milestones.evidence: Clean-room runs created isolated Treehouse worktrees and validated that the task pane entered the expected worktree.

north_star_milestones.name: Herdr task endpoint
north_star_milestones.evidence: Flat Herdr fallback created a task tab/pane endpoint after presentation-lock fallback; the presentation warning itself was not causal.

north_star_milestones.name: Worker Pi launch
north_star_milestones.evidence: Several independent Windows/MSYS blockers were fixed, but the final clean-room run still timed out before creating a worktree or task pane.

implemented_windows_compatibility_layers.result: Windows Node callers invoke tracked .sh scripts through bash instead of direct spawn, avoiding EFTYPE while preserving POSIX direct execution.
Introduced Windows ancestry support derived from the upstream session-lock work.
Added Win32 process-information capability handling for lock ownership/liveness.
Recognized native node.exe Pi CLI identity without accepting unrelated Node processes.
Allowed the Pi extension to pass FM_NATIVE_HARNESS_PID so Windows session acquisition does not depend on MSYS ancestry reaching node.exe.
Replaced unsupported symlink-style directory lock publication with Windows/MSYS-safe direct directory locking.
Added regression hardening around the direct-directory lock behavior.
Resolved the native treehouse executable for shells/panes where bare treehouse was unavailable.
Used recent-unwrapped machine-readable capture so long Windows paths are not soft-wrapped during Git-root validation.
Moved the complex POSIX worker payload into a task-local launch.sh and reduced cmd.exe to launching bash.exe plus the script path.
Bootstrapped /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin in generated launch scripts so env and env-shebang helpers resolve when bash.exe is started directly from cmd.exe.
Classified foreground shell family through Herdr and applied MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL only for MSYS/Bash before invoking cmd.exe /d /s /c, preserving cmd and PowerShell behavior.

important_live_findings: Herdr presentation focus-lock failure is best-effort and was proven non-causal; the flat fallback proceeds to container/task creation.
Herdr structured pane cwd can remain stale on native Windows after Treehouse changes directory; a dedicated Git-root query is required for validation.
Git Bash/MSYS can rewrite Windows-style /d /s /c switches into drive-like paths before cmd.exe receives them.
Starting bash.exe directly from cmd.exe does not guarantee a useful POSIX PATH; launch.sh must establish the minimum Git-Bash tool path itself.
A manual bin/fm-session-start.sh invocation is not a faithful substitute for Pi's automatic Windows extension path because the automatic path injects FM_NATIVE_HARNESS_PID.
A clean-room environment materially changed diagnosis quality; reusing failed tasks, Herdr endpoints, locks, and worktrees produced ambiguous pre-metadata timeouts.

final_clean_room_result.head: 3185094bbc7e9ad9288013f68bb6cde71a94f1e9
final_clean_room_result.interpretation: The final clean-room run exposed another independent pre-worktree blocker after the previously identified Windows/MSYS fixes. Per the spike stop rule, no further diagnosis was authorized.

parked_or_unfinished_items.reason: Stop rule reached: another independent blocker appeared after the last allowed focused fix.

parked_or_unfinished_items.item: Herdr Windows socket canonicalization in teardown
parked_or_unfinished_items.reason: Known mismatch between Windows socket paths and POSIX-only canonicalization. It did not block the measured spawn milestones and was deferred to lifecycle closure.
Not allowed to expand the spike unless worker result return became the active North Star blocker.
The native Primary session path was already proven through the Pi extension; restart hardening was not required for the happy-path proof.

decision.meaning: The accumulated fixes demonstrate that several individual Firstmate layers can operate natively on Windows, but the end-to-end spawn path is not yet deterministic enough for real .NET/WPF work.
decision.operational_recommendation: Do not use this branch as a production Windows-native Firstmate environment. Continue real work through the already-proven non-native/compatibility path until Windows support is treated as a dedicated porting and hardening project.
decision.why_stop: The spike uncovered a sequence of independent incompatibilities rather than one dominant blocker. After the final allowed focused fix, a new blocker still appeared before worker creation. Continuing would turn the compatibility spike into an open-ended Windows port.

resume_contract.when_to_resume: Only as an explicit Windows-native porting/hardening project with its own budget and acceptance criteria.
resume_contract.start_from: The archived documentation commit that supersedes pre-documentation head 3185094bbc7e9ad9288013f68bb6cde71a94f1e9.
resume_contract.first_question: Diagnose the final clean-room pre-worktree timeout before adding any new compatibility layer.
resume_contract.test_rule: Use a fresh clone, fresh Firstmate home/state, fresh named Herdr session, and exactly one spawn per hypothesis. Do not reuse failed task/runtime state as a validation bed.
resume_contract.acceptance_gate: Do not claim native Windows viability until one clean-room run completes worker creation, brief delivery, a real .NET/WPF edit, native Windows build/tests, result return to Primary, and normal task closure.

archival.note: After this documentation commit, both refs should point at the same final documented snapshot before auxiliary spike branches and local disposable clones are removed.
